description: This file implements an Android activity that manages a card flip animation demo. It creates and manages two stacks of cards, handles user gestures (taps and flings) to rotate cards or full stacks with animations, and manages layout and interaction logic for flipping cards horizontally.

classes.name: CardFlip
classes.description: Main activity class that manages the card flip animation demo, user interactions, and layout.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the layout, gesture detectors, and adds initial cards.

methods.name: addNewCard
methods.description: Adds a new card to a specified stack and sets its layout parameters.

methods.name: getStack
methods.description: Determines which stack a gesture event occurred in based on the X coordinate.

methods.name: rotateCardView
methods.description: Handles flipping a single card with animation, updating its position in the stack.

methods.name: rotateCards
methods.description: Creates animations to flip all cards in a stack either out or in with specified corner rotation.

methods.name: rotateCardsFullRotation
methods.description: Creates animations to perform a full rotation around a specified corner for all cards in a stack.
